description: Use this when you need to know which inboxes exist on the signed-in account, for example to pick an inbox_id before sending or reading mail, or to tell the user their address. Read-only; requires auth. Inputs: status (optional; active or paused; omit to list every inbox), q (optional case-insensitive substring of email, username, or display_name; prefix matches come first), label (optional exact label), limit (optional; default 100, maximum 500), page_token (optional cursor). Returns {data:[{id, username, email, display_name, created_at, require_sender_auth, labels, expires_at, status, paused_at, metadata, client_id, signature}], next_page_token}. signature is {text, html} or null. A limit outside 1 to 500 returns HTTP 400 invalid_limit. A bad page_token returns HTTP 400 invalid_page_token. An unknown status returns 400 invalid_status.

label.description: Optional exact label. Only inboxes that carry this label are returned.

limit.description: Page size. Default 100. Maximum 500. Outside 1 to 500 returns invalid_limit.

page_token.description: Cursor from next_page_token. A bad token returns invalid_page_token.

q.description: Optional case-insensitive substring of email, username, or display_name. Prefix matches are listed first. % and _ match those characters.

status.description: Optional filter. active or paused. Omit to list every inbox.

name: cooper_list_inboxes

outputSchema.description: One page of inboxes on the account.

data.description: Items on this page, in the order the tool description gives.

client_id.description: Caller idempotency key stored with the object, or null.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

email.description: Full email address of the inbox.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object expires, or null for no expiry.

id.description: Inbox id (inb_…). Pass it as inbox_id to other tools.

metadata.description: Caller key-value data stored on the object.

paused_at.description: ISO-8601 time the inbox was paused, or null.

require_sender_auth.description: When true, only mail that passes DMARC/DKIM can create an owner task.

screening.description: Inbound screening mode: off, observe, or hold.

send_mode.description: direct sends immediately. approval turns sends into drafts a verified owner approves.

signature.description: Signature {text, html} added to sends, or null.

next_page_token.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when this is the last page. Pass it back as page_token.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

title: List inboxes
